split_rule: the classifier's own capture-group-aware train/val/test split
circularity_warning: Labels whose provenance is `classifier_verdict` (gate) or `rule_verifier` (claims) come from the very component the model is meant to cross-check. A cross-judge trained on them can only reproduce that component's errors; a gate trained on the classifier's verdict cannot disagree with the classifier. Group-aware splitting fixes train/test leakage, not label provenance circularity.
